button.name: action_cancel_contract
button.confirm: Are you sure you want to cancel this contract?

button.name: action_reactivate_contract
button.confirm: Are you sure you want to reactivate this contract?

button.name: action_archive
button.confirm: Are you sure you want to archive this record?

button.name: action_move_to_auctions_portfolio
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want to Send This Property to Auctions Portfolio?

button.name: action_sales_contract_with_buyer
button.invisible: sales_auction_stage_selection != 'p2_shared_buyer_contracting' or is_contract_with_buyer == True or is_auctions_pm_group == False
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want to proceed to Contract with Buyer?

button.name: action_sales_move_to_sales_fin
button.invisible: sales_auction_stage_selection != 'p2_shared_buyer_contracting' or is_contract_with_buyer == False or is_auctions_pm_group == False
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want to Send This Property To Sales And Finance?

button.name: action_move_to_collection
button.invisible: sales_auction_stage_selection != 'p2_shared_sales_fin' or is_sold != 'yes' or is_sale_cancelled or is_commercial_accountant_group == False
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want to Move This Property To Collection and Discharge?

button.name: action_sales_move_to_archive
button.invisible: not( (sales_auction_stage_selection == 'p2_shared_sales_fin' and is_sold == 'no' and is_commercial_accountant_group == True) or (sales_auction_stage_selection == 'p2_shared_col_trans' and is_collection_officer_group == True) )
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want To Move This Property To Sales Archive

button.name: action_cancel_sale
button.invisible: sales_auction_stage_selection != 'p2_shared_sales_fin' or is_sale_cancelled or is_sold == 'no' or is_commercial_accountant_group == False
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want to Cancel This Sale?

button.name: action_confirm_cancellation_and_archive
button.invisible: not (is_sale_cancelled == True and sales_auction_stage_selection == 'p2_shared_sales_fin') or is_commercial_accountant_group == False
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want to Confirm Cancellation and Archive This Property?

button.name: action_return_from_archive
button.confirm: Are You Sure You Want to Return This Property To Portfolio?

page.name: contract_with_buyer_page
page.invisible: sales_auction_stage_selection not in ['p2_shared_buyer_contracting', 'p2_shared_sales_fin', 'p2_shared_col_trans', 'p2_sales_archive'] or is_contract_with_buyer == False

div.span: Collected amount does not match the selling price. Request will be sent to sector manager approval.
